1934, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Ella Joseph Murray - 47 - Goiter operation to-morrow at 9 a.m. Rev. James Fogarty- about 60 - appendicitis operation To-day - Mental ... llyrs.
Sarbinowski in Providence - nervous break - son studying. A.McDonald - 49 - Discouraged losing faith - wife not well. Mrs. Dunn - 54 - 8 mo. nervous worries .... boy hurt in hospital. Cicylia Jutowski - 23 - "possessed? M. Gagush - 5 - infantile Parl. Mother (non Cath. ) 4 month with some .... is improving since last week.
Page 194 May 10 Gillaert Vereecke - 7 - wants to be Capuchin - tumor on brain took convulsion This a.m. on way from hospital ... bright.
Mary - 70 - knocked down ... in Hosp. now.
11 Cameron Smith - 35-40 - was hesitating about Real Presence while taking instruction, had prolonged argument with atheist in defense of the B. V. Mary devotion .... was baptized May 8. Holy Com. next day.
11 C. & R. Murray of Chicago - young couple with baby - quarrling . Her mother enrolls poor souls (2.00) for Int. that they improve.
Louis Huncau - 36 - heart- trouble & nerves - has wife & 2 little children to provide for.
14 Ellen Cronin - 73 - 18 yrs. paralysed. .
Kenneth M. J. Kunert - 8 - peculiarly sore throat .... Merlin Reffinburg - 23 - arthritis - in hospital Ann Arbor - to be married in June .hopeless.
Mr. M. Gerardo - 70 - broken hip-in cast & fearful pain. Alfred Martz Jr. - 7 - threatened mastoid. Cecelia Autowski - 23 - possessed ??? Rose Liss - 68 - Eyes.
